throat_midpoint.rule: midline, y in [0.30, 0.55], z>0.02 anterior; argmax y

c7.rule: midline, y in [0.20, 0.55], z<-0.02 posterior; argmax y

acromion_left.rule: side=left, |x| in [0.13, 0.22] (torso width — not arm), y in [0.23, 0.32], |z|<0.10; argmax y (top of shoulder pad)

acromion_right.rule: side=right, |x| in [0.13, 0.22] (torso width — not arm), y in [0.23, 0.32], |z|<0.10; argmax y (top of shoulder pad)

greater_trochanter_left.rule: side=left, y in [-0.15, 0.05]; argmax|min x (most lateral)

greater_trochanter_right.rule: side=right, y in [-0.15, 0.05]; argmax|min x (most lateral)

lateral_epicondyle_left.rule: side=left, y in [-0.80, -0.50]; argmax|min x (most lateral)

lateral_epicondyle_right.rule: side=right, y in [-0.80, -0.50]; argmax|min x (most lateral)

lateral_malleolus_left.rule: side=left, y in [-1.15, -0.95]; argmax|min x (most lateral)

lateral_malleolus_right.rule: side=right, y in [-1.15, -0.95]; argmax|min x (most lateral)
